# pvecli vm unlock

Unlock a VM - requires root@pam authentication.

```text
pvecli vm unlock [VMID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
